```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(microbenchmark)

source("curve_reformat.R")
```

```{r}
usa <- read.csv("reconstructed-data/usa-bs.csv")
gbr <- read.csv("reconstructed-data/gbr-bs.csv")
jpn <- read.csv("reconstructed-data/jpn-bs.csv")
cad <- read.csv("reconstructed-data/cad-bs.csv")

yields <- list(usa, gbr, jpn, cad)
curves <- c("usa", "gbr", "jpn", "cad")
mats <- c(1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 60, 84, 120, 240, 360) 
lambdas <- seq(0.01, 0.1, by = 0.001)
```

```{r}
## testing 

source("ns_core.R")
source("bl_single_curve.R")
source("bl_feature_extract.R")

lambda_select_usa <- lambda_grid_search(lambdas, usa[1:250,], mats)
lambda_select_gbr <- lambda_grid_search(lambdas, gbr[1:250,], mats)
lambda_select_jpn <- lambda_grid_search(lambdas, jpn[1:250,], mats)
lambda_select_cad <- lambda_grid_search(lambdas, cad[1:250,], mats)

#microbenchmark(
#  func1 = lambda_grid_search(lambdas, usa[1:100,], mats), 
#  func2 = lambda_grid_search2(lambdas, usa[1:100,], mats), 
#  times = 100L  # Number of repetitions
#)

usa_curve <- bl_single_curve(lambda_select_usa, usa[1:250, ], c(4, 8), mats)
gbr_curve <- bl_single_curve(lambda_select_gbr, gbr[1:250, ], c(4, 8), mats)
jpn_curve <- bl_single_curve(lambda_select_jpn, jpn[1:250, ], c(4, 8), mats)
cad_curve <- bl_single_curve(lambda_select_cad, cad[1:250, ], c(4, 8), mats) 

tsc_list <- transpose(setNames(list(usa_curve, gbr_curve, jpn_curve, cad_curve), curves))
test_ccVARs <- blcc_cointegration(tsc_list, curves = curves, reference = "usa")

Xt = blcc_build_Xt(test_ccVARs$cc_cspread,)
W = blcc_build_Wj(tsc_list$nsfit, mats)
H <- bdiag(usa_curve$H, gbr_curve$H, jpn_curve$H, cad_curve$H)

```

```{r}
source("cr_core_estim.R")
test_BS0 <- blcc_fe(Xt=Xt, Wt=W, mats=mats, init="adaptive")
ts <- tSigma_optim(test_BS0, Xt)

```
